name: Draconia Malfoid (uniform)
description: An unofficial, non-commercial fan character, Draconia Malfoid, loosely inspired by Draco Malfoy, in a black hooded robe lined with dark green over a white shirt, a green-and-silver striped tie, a grey vest and a grey pleated skirt, with long platinum-blonde hair. Not affiliated with Warner Bros. or Wizarding World: read the NOTICE that comes with the pack. The pictures were made with AI.
